topic: How to Stop Quitting Fitness Every 2 Weeks
caption:
Stop starting your fitness journey every Monday bro.
Extreme diets aur 2-hour gym workouts hamesha burnout karwate hain.
Real secret hai small daily wins jo lifetime sustain ho sakein.
Slide through for simple consistency rules that actually work.
